test_normalize_plausibilities: test the eval_utils normalize_plausibilities function to normalize samples to plausibilities along the last dimension
test_rankk_certainties: test the eval_utils rankk_certainties function to compute rank-k certainties from plausibilities and risk groups
test_map_across_plausibilities: test the eval_utils map_across_plausibilities function to apply a metric across all plausibilities per example
test_bootstrap_readers: test the eval_utils bootstrap_readers function to bootstrap committee readers for each example
test_bootstrap_aggregated_rankings: test the eval_utils bootstrap_aggregated_rankings function to bootstrap aggregated rankings with IRN aggregation
test_majority_vote: test the eval_utils majority_vote function to majority vote the result of a function over plausibilities
